integrity: The group is decomposed into true-twin classes indexed by p-lines; an exact necessary-and-sufficient forcing criterion is proved and counted, and an explicit real symmetric Gram representation of rank t+2 matches the graph pattern. The standalone verifier checks class dynamics, direct group power-containment graphs, polynomial coefficients, and the rank witness.
scientific_limitations: The primes p and q are distinct and odd and d is at least two.
The identity-deleted proper power graph is used.
The singleton-class boundaries p=2 or q=2 are not covered.
No extension to higher p-power exponents is asserted.
title: Zero forcing polynomial and minimum rank of proper power graphs of \(C_p^d\times C_q\)
